# Workspace instructions

- This repository is a NestJS TypeScript app that serves its static landing page from `public/`.
- Keep the public site responsive, accessible, and usable with reduced-motion preferences.
- All inquiry links must target WhatsApp number +91 7594 880 033 and include a relevant prefilled message.
- Keep investment figures clearly attributed to Adams-provided information; do not present projections as verified or guaranteed.
- Keep the 19 property services in the supplied order.
- Run `npm run build` after backend changes and `npm run lint` when practical.
